purpose: Map every manuscript-facing claim to its frozen evidence, quantitative result, null/control, provenance, and the exact language allowed in the manuscript. Ledger statuses are separate from evidence polarity: SUPPORTED (evidence backs the claim), NEGATIVE (evidence backs the inverse), UNRESOLVED (evidence leaves the outcome open), METHOD_ONLY (claim is about the method, not an empirical outcome), UNSUPPORTED (no qualifying frozen evidence).

statistics_regime.deterministic_numerical_property: Exact numeric value from a fixed-configuration run; no inference from randomness; report as Absolute
statistics_regime.deterministic_numerical_property across: Fixed configuration repeated over multiple recorded seeds; property holds per run (e.g. E5 causal outcome, 3/3). For protocols with spec noise_scale=0 these are deterministic repetitions, not stochastic replication units.
statistics_regime.factorial_point_estimates: Finite factorial of factors (e.g. H4 2x2 delay x heterogeneity); point estimates only, no bootstrap CIs computed (exploratory)
statistics_regime.lattice_scan_deterministic_gates: Deterministic pass/fail gates over a scan (e.g. A_adapt domain classification)
statistics_regime.method_boundary_statement: Statement defining method scope, not an empirical result
statistics_regime.method_reproducibility: Reproduction-path property of the repository itself
statistics_regime.parameter_space_characterization: Scan over protocol-defined parameter lattice with deterministic gates (e.g. H3 nulls, W3b domain)
statistics_regime.representational_document: Specification/grammar artifact, not an empirical measurement

validation_floor: No claim cites a bootstrap or parametric CI that was not computed; H4 exploratory point estimates explicitly exclude bootstrap CIs
Null-gated comparisons are certified via CHANCE_MARGIN=0.12 / ABOVE_CHANCE=0.08 gates in the H3 analysis

No seed-robustness claim is made anywhere: all Protocol D/E specs set noise_scale=0, so recorded seeds are nominal metadata of deterministic runs (corrected 2026-08-21, ox-alpha resolution pass; original wording claimed seed robustness for E5: 11/12/13)

Historical environment provenance limitation (accepted 2026-08-22, owner ruling): sealed receipts generated before this date record SHA/version/seed identity but not wall-clock/python/jax/platform; that absence is permanent and must NOT be reconstructed as contemporaneous metadata. All post-ruling evidence carries the full provenance schema.
